title: IRDAI Mandates Four-Layer Motor Insurance Structure for Cars and Two-Wheelers From December 15
court: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India
case_name: IRDAI Circular on the Four-Layer Motor Insurance Policy Structure for Private Cars and Two-Wheelers
citation: Circular No. IRDAI/CIR/MOT/10/2026 dated 2 November 2026, issued under Section 14(2) of the Insurance Act, 1938
card_summary: IRDAI's Circular IRDAI/CIR/MOT/10/2026, dated 2 November 2026, directs general insurers, barring health and specialised insurers, to sell car and two-wheeler policies in four layers from 15 December 2026. Only third-party liability stays compulsory; occupant liability, personal accident cover and own-damage become separate optional layers, with Bima Sugam integration and a customer option form at purchase.
card_tip: When buying a car or two-wheeler policy after 15 December, ask for the customer option form and choose each optional layer, occupant liability, personal accident and own-damage, on its own terms.
verification_notes: AUDIENCE: HNI individuals and family businesses running multiple vehicles who will see premiums broken into separately priced layers, with a secondary domestic-consumer angle for all private car and two-wheeler owners. TARGET QUERY: what is the new four-layer motor insurance policy from December 2026. DEMAND EVIDENCE: none seen. Cross-verified from Moneylife, Upstox and Cafemutual, which agree on the circular number IRDAI/CIR/MOT/10/2026 dated 2 November 2026, the 15 December 2026 effective date, the exclusion of stand-alone health and specialised insurers, the compulsory Layer I third-party cover with three optional layers (occupant or pillion legal liability, personal accident cover, own-damage protection), the Section 14(2) Insurance Act basis, the mandatory customer option form, and simultaneous Bima Sugam integration. Reports attribute the four-layer structure to an earlier Supreme Court direction, but that order was not independently opened in this run. The IRDAI circular text itself was not opened directly.
